name: Stratagem Probe (research)
description: Research for Commando Plus: can a Resupply be delivered somewhere other than where its beacon landed (at the reinforcement pods)? Hooks the game's beacon activation; for the Resupply you throw, Ctrl+Alt+F3 picks: redirect (default: to the nearest pod site in Commando, else 20 m east), copies (one more per pod site), observe. Logs where everything lands. Turn off when done.
